facts.fact: UNICEF Rwanda reports that the head teacher of Nyarubuye Primary School (Rwamagana District) frequently updates the online School Data Management System, which holds real-time data for the school's 777 students and 20 teachers including student grades and attendance; the story is undated, so the document's published date is used.

UNICEF Rwanda describes the School Data Management System in use at a primary school, Nyarubuye Primary School in Rwamagana District, where the head teacher enters the data; undated, so the published date is used.

UNICEF Rwanda describes the School Data Management System as in use at one named primary school and as the head teacher's responsibility, and gives no count or share of schools entering data; undated, so the published date is used.

systems.platform: online; zero-rated on Airtel SIM cards
systems.tiers: school: the head teacher updates it; records students' grades and attendance and teachers, and is used to request money to run the school
